name: Chocolate Chip Cookies (Vegan)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 cups flour (whole wheat pastry flour recommended but all-purpose white also works)

steps: Cream shortening, margarine, and sugar together in a mixer.
Add banana to the sugar and butter mixture.
Mix all the dry ingredients together. Slowly add to the wet mixture.
Roll small portions of dough into balls and place on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 10–11 minutes, or until slightly browned.

culture.text: A chocolate chip cookie is a drop cookie that contains pieces of chocolate mixed into the dough before baking. Texture and appearance vary with ingredients and preparation, ranging from moist, chewy cookies to ones that are crispy.
